module: Graphics settings: display mode (windowed, fullscreen, borderless), resolution, refresh rate, display driver, HDR, anti-aliasing, upscaling, quality groups (meshes, textures, lighting, shadows, terrain, clouds, dynamic reflections and mirrors, clustered lighting), post-processing (DOF, motion blur, SSAO, SSR, screen-space shadows) and global presets (settingsPresets.json). It provides core_settings_settings with the "option helpers" (get/set) of these settings and applies the video state to the Canvas. A modder mostly uses it via core_settings_settings.setValue; setPresetOverride lets you temporarily enforce a preset.
usage:
-- enforce the 'Low' preset without changing the saved choice
core_settings_graphic.setPresetOverride({name = 'Low', enforce = true})
-- release
core_settings_graphic.setPresetOverride(nil)
notes: The file is very large (over 2000 lines): most of it is in buildOptionHelpers, which returns a table whose keys are: GraphicDisplayModes, GraphicDisplayResolutions, GraphicDisplayRefreshRates, GraphicDisplayDriver, GraphicGPU, WindowPlacement, uiUpscaling, vulkanEnabled, GraphicHDRSupported/Enabled/PaperWhiteNits/PeakWhiteNits/UiMultiplier/OutputModeName, GraphicEVCompensation, vsync, GraphicAntialiasType, GraphicUpscalingQuality, GraphicUpscalingSharpness, GraphicAntialias, GraphicAnisotropic, GraphicPlatformPreset, GraphicOverallQuality, GraphicMeshQuality, GraphicTerrainQuality, GraphicTextureQuality, GraphicLightingQuality, GraphicShadowsQuality, GraphicDynReflectionQuality, GraphicDynReflectionFacesPerupdate, GraphicDynMirrorsQuality, GraphicCloudsQuality, PostFXDOFGeneralEnabled, PostFXMotionBlurEnabled/Strength/PlayerVehicle, PostFXSSAOGeneralEnabled/Quality, PostFXSpecularOcclusionEnabled, PostFXSSRAvailable/Enabled/Quality, PostFXScreenSpaceShadowsAvailable/Enabled, GraphicGrassDensity, GraphicMaxDecalCount, lastSplitCastersEnabled, vehicleShadowEnabled, GraphicClusteredQuality.

The quality groups use core_settings_graphicsQualityGroup with the modules lightingQuality, shadowsQuality, textureQuality, meshQuality and terrainQuality; clusteredQuality and dynCaptureQuality are called directly.
autoDetectApplyGraphicsQuality is empty (the whole body is commented out, with a TODO from 2021): calling this function does nothing. openMonitorConfiguration is also empty.
In onInitSettings, setting Vulkan from the settings is disabled by an 'if false'.
The keys PostFXDOFGeneralEnabled and PostFXMotionBlur* keep the user's value when a platform preset is applied (platformPresetUserOwnedKeys).
setPresetOverride: while an override is active, the saved GraphicOverallQuality choice can change but stays unapplied; with enforce, the preset values are re-enforced on every settings change.

appliedChanges.desc: True when applyGraphicsState has just run; reset to false when leaving the graphics options menu.

skipWindowPlacementRestore.desc: If true, applyGraphicsState resizes the window to the chosen resolution instead of restoring the saved position.

selected_displayMode.desc: Last known display mode (Window, Fullscreen, Borderless).

buildOptionHelpers.desc: Builds and stores the table of graphics options (get/set/getModes and optionally sanitize, init, onSettingsChanged per option). Called by core_settings_settings.initSettings.

onInitSettings.desc: Hook called by core_settings_settings.initSettings: calls init(value) on each graphics option that has one, with the value read.

onFirstUpdateSettings.desc: Hook called at the end of settings initialization: if $forceFullscreen is true, forces the default settings in fullscreen; shows the window (canvas:showWindow), collects display information and cleans up the anti-aliasing type. No effect if the Canvas does not exist.

refreshGraphicsState.desc: Synchronizes the internal state (mode, driver, resolution, refresh rate, window placement) with a new settings state, cleans up invalid values (sanitize), notifies the UI and emits the hook onDisplayModeChanged(oldMode, newMode) if the mode changed. A WindowPlacement change is saved immediately.

newState.desc: Settings containing GraphicDisplayDriver, GraphicDisplayModes, GraphicDisplayResolutions, GraphicDisplayRefreshRates, WindowPlacement (all optional).

applyGraphicsState.desc: Applies the chosen video mode to the engine: requests saving, sets the display device (GFXDevice.setDisplayDevice) and the video mode (width, height, refresh rate, mode), applies HDR, restores the window position, then sets the rendering mode (SingleMonitor or MultiMonitor depending on GraphicTripleMonitorEnabled and the triple-screen FOVs). Ignored if already in progress, or if the Canvas is absent (after the save request).

load.desc: Called by core_settings_settings.load: refreshGraphicsState(newState) then applyGraphicsState().

onUiChangedState.desc: UI state change hook. On entering 'menu.options.graphics', stores the display state; on leaving, if the changes were not applied, restores the old mode, resolution and refresh rate.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Called after every settings save. With an active override: re-enforces the preset if enforce, otherwise does nothing. Without an override: reruns GraphicPlatformPreset.onSettingsChanged and GraphicOverallQuality.onSettingsChanged.

onUpdate.desc: Update hook: counts down the deferred timers for the render scale and the HDR output mode, then applies them on expiry.

toggleFullscreen.desc: Toggles fullscreen/windowed on the Canvas (canvas:toggleFullscreen) if it exists.

openCoconutWindow.desc: Opens the rendering "Coconut" debug window (Engine.Render.setCoconutWindowOpen(true)). No effect in a shipping build.

autoDetectApplyGraphicsQuality.desc: Intended to automatically choose a quality based on video memory; entirely commented out in the code, so inactive.

getOptions.desc: Returns a specific option helper or the whole graphics options table.

optionName.desc: Option name (e.g. 'GraphicDisplayModes'). nil = the whole table.

getDisplayInformation.desc: Returns the display information collected at startup (GPU, screens...) for the UI.

setPresetOverride.desc: Enforces a global preset without changing the saved GraphicOverallQuality choice. Passing nil releases the override and restores the saved preset. With enforce = true, the values are re-enforced on every settings change.

override.desc: name = name of a preset from settingsPresets.json.

returns.desc: false if the preset is not found, otherwise true.

getOverallQualityPresets.desc: Returns the table of global presets read from lua/ge/extensions/core/settings/settingsPresets.json.
